metadata.design: One row/object per scholarship-document requirement. Conditional documents are kept distinct from mandatory documents.
metadata.verification_policy: Official/current provider sources are preferred. Current partner/secondary sources are labeled. Unverified current document sets are represented as evidence-gate placeholders rather than fabricated checklists.
metadata.usage: Use for Smart Document Checklist, missing-document detection, document validation routing, and RAG grounding.
metadata.important: A missing document generally means the eligibility decision may need MORE INFORMATION; it does not automatically mean the student fails the underlying eligibility condition.
